description: This file defines the 'Wishlist' model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to add, delete, retrieve, and count wishlist records for customers, interacting with the database accordingly.

classes.name: Wishlist
classes.description: A model class handling customer wishlist operations such as adding, removing, and retrieving wishlist data from the database.

methods.name: addWishlist
methods.description: Creates or updates a customer wishlist record by inserting the product into the customer's wishlist, replacing any existing entry for that product.

methods.name: deleteWishlists
methods.description: Removes wishlist entries for a customer, optionally filtering by a specific product.

methods.name: getWishlist
methods.description: Retrieves all wishlist entries for a specified customer.

methods.name: getTotalWishlist
methods.description: Counts the total number of wishlist entries for a customer.
